newsitem.title: UK: Ukraine fund raises $82 mln - Societe Generale.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine fund raises $82 mln - Societe Generale.

text.p: Societe Generale Emerging Europe Asset Management (SGEEAM) said Thursday it has raised $82 million for the Ukrainian Fund it launched a week ago with partner Ladenburg Thalmann International.
The funds, which exceeded a target of $50 million, came largely from European and North American investors.
"There are a growing number of international investors who are eager to get exposure to the Ukraine at an early stage of its development," said SGEEAM managing director Richard Harding.

"As the Ukraine's capital markets grow and become more liquid, there is an expectation that share values will reflect more accurately their intrinsic value. That is what has spurred interest in our fund."
Sponsoring agent Societe Generale European Emerging Markets will be making a market in the fund beginning July 14. -- James Saft, London newsroom +171 542 2734
